fixes.summary: Fix intermittent stock-comparison PDF test failures by retaining a valid trailing carriage-return byte in compressed streams. A deterministic binary regression reproduces the old reader corruption; production PDF output is unchanged.
Complete Shopify order line-item pagination rather than silently truncating oversized orders. Regression fixtures cover continuation and malformed/repeated pages.
Accept a header-only SwipeSimple tax report as an empty period instead of stopping the backfill. A parser regression fixture covers the empty export.
Bound MCP request-body reads even when Content-Length is absent or understated. Request regression tests exercise the actual byte limit.
Compare update requests and updater reports in whole seconds so an already handled request no longer appears pending. A same-second regression test covers this case.
